label: ريم — نجدية
ref_text: نبدأ بمراجعة كتابة الرمز، لأن أي مسافة أو حرف مختلف ممكن يمنع قبوله.
source: omnivoice-finetune/data/najdi_cs/wavs/najdi_cs_3_najdi_cs_f_08_clean_004.wav (id najdi_cs_00337, cut from set 3's najdi_cs_f_08_clean.wav; no najdi_cs clip is in najdi_v4, so the shipped checkpoint never trained on this voice)
notes: The female voice of the synthetic najdi_cs customer-support sets, where the agent calls herself Reem (sets 7-11), Noura (set 3) and Sara (set 13): one synthesiser voice under several names (speaker similarity 0.87 across its 74 recordings). She is not the trained voice Nora. No model here trained on her; the omnivoice_najdi model only clones her. From set 3. Picked from 42 candidate segments of 5-9 s: of the eight cloned on eight unseen sentences with the shipped model (najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250), this one gave the closest clones (similarity 0.827, next 0.826) with the highest UTMOS (3.67). It replaced the set-11 clip chosen with the v3 model, which it beat on both: similarity +0.022 +/- 0.008, UTMOS +0.195 +/- 0.075.

language_check.model: najdi_v4_ft/checkpoint-6250, 20 held-out Najdi lines and 20 held-out MSA lines, each code
